summary: Organigram Global Inc. filed a Form 6-K (equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K) attaching a news release announcing an arrangement agreement to acquire all outstanding common shares of Aurora Cannabis at C$7.80 per share, valuing Aurora at roughly C$561 million on a fully diluted basis. The C$7.80 consideration reflects a 93% premium to Aurora's August 10, 2026 unaffected TSX close and a 21% premium to Curaleaf's amended hostile bid value as of November 2, 2026. Both boards unanimously support the deal; directors, officers and a major Organigram shareholder signed voting support agreements. Watch the competing Curaleaf hostile bid, the cash/stock proration election and regulatory timing.
